title: "Validation"
subtitle: "Convergent evidence and time-series diagnostics"

## Validation strategy

Validation is interpreted as **convergent empirical consistency**.

It does not establish causality and does not convert the available
proxies into Basel III regulatory metrics.

## Mechanical-overlap correction

P1 and P2 partially overlap with indicators included in the baseline
index.

The pipeline therefore reconstructs the ICVLF after removing the
corresponding overlapping component.

- ADF: unit root;
- PP: unit root;
- KPSS: stationarity.

The combined interpretation therefore considers convergence rather
than relying on a single test.
